_crawl.linkedin_about: WHERE DO WE START? How about Kansas City? That’s our home. That’s where Garmin put a stake in the ground in 1989. We’ve grown substantially over the years, offering diverse products and global reach in 5 diverse markets. But some things won’t ever change: Our entrepreneurial spirit and a culture where everyone’s opinion matters. That’s because we believe it’s possible to light the tech world on fire and still be on a first name basis. BIG IDEAS, SMALL EGOS What we do best is make products that let our customers do what they love. To do that, we focus on practical innovation, never losing sight of the benefits our products bring to our customers. Sure, we love bells and whistles. What leading technology company doesn't? But we make sure ours have purpose. It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible. WE’RE GLOBAL, SERIOUSLY. Yeah, we’re based in Kansas City, but we are truly a global company. With offices throughout Europe, Asia, Middle East, South America and Australia, our products are sold all over the world. One elevator ride at our headquarters and you’re likely to hear 4 (or more) different languages being spoken. At Garmin, we may act local, but we think global. DREAM BIG. SLEEP WELL. At Garmin, we like to encourage dreamers. But at some point it’s nice to wake up and enjoy a fully aware life. So we make it super easy to achieve a good balance between working, dreaming and enjoying life—from workout classes offered throughout the day, breaks to get out and move on our campus, and wellness programs offered throughout the year. It’s almost impossible not to take advantage of Garmin’s work-life balance opportunities.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Step into the world of LG Electronics, a global innovator in technology and consumer electronics focused on creating solutions for a better life. Guided by our brand promise, Life’s Good, we aim to make everyday life better, smarter and more meaningful for people around the world. With a history spanning more than six decades, a network of more than 100 subsidiaries, and an international workforce of over 75,000, LG Electronics operates on a truly global scale. Since our founding in 1958, we have remained focused on delivering innovative products and technologies that improve lives around the world. Through our four business divisions — Home Appliance Solution, Media Entertainment Solution, Vehicle Solution, and Eco Solution Companies — we provide innovative products and services that enhance everyday life across residential, entertainment, mobility, and HVAC sectors. At the same time, we continue to expand into new growth areas including AI Home, smart factories, robotics and platform-based services such as webOS, building on our strengths in both consumer technology and B2B solutions. Our management philosophy, Jeong-do Management, reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency and doing business the right way. Built on the principles of customer value creation and people-oriented management, our culture encourages collaboration, creativity and growth. Join us as we continue to shape what comes next, because at LG, Life’s Good.

to other time-saving tools that allow you to scan a barcode or individual foods with your phone's
camera to instantly identify the best match. [Learn more about Premium and try it free][9].

global foods in one of the world's largest food databases — including fresh foods, packaged goods,
restaurant items, and even foods and recipes you save yourself.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile, and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. Advanced connectivity is key to enable the opportunities of AI – opening new doors for us and our customers. Once known for connecting people, our technology is now essential to connecting intelligence. Our priority is to deliver superior performance with the trust and security our customers need and we’re a committed innovation partner, shaping the future of connectivity. For our latest updates, please visit us online www.nokia.com To view open positions and to apply, please visit: www.nokia.com/careers

_crawl.linkedin_about: Samsung Electronics is a global leader in technology, opening new possibilities for people everywhere. Through relentless innovation and discovery, we are transforming the worlds of TVs, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, digital appliances, network systems, medical devices, semiconductors and LED solutions. Samsung is also leading in the Internet of Things space through, among others, our Smart Home and Digital Health initiatives. Since being established in 1969, Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, and become recognized as one of the top 10 global brands. Our network now extends across the world, and Samsung takes great pride in the creativity and diversity of its talented people, who drive our growth. To discover more, please visit our website at www.samsung.com and our official newsroom at news.samsung.com

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Sony’s purpose is simple. We aim to fill the world with emotion, through the power of creativity and technology. We want to be responsible for getting hearts racing, stirring ambition, and putting a smile on the faces of our customers. That challenge, combined with our spirit of innovation, motivates us to create groundbreaking technology, entertainment, and services for people worldwide. Our history as a global brand has been built around employees that all have a passion for touching peoples'​ lives, and pride in pushing beyond the status quo to produce truly extraordinary results. We’re uniquely positioned because we operate in many different industries - from movies and music to video games and electronics. And, with offices around the globe, we benefit from a global workforce that learns and grows together through mutual respect. If you're ready to join a diverse team at an innovation-led company with the power to change lives, then we encourage you to read up on the different Sony group companies and check out our Life page. Then, get in touch, and together, let’s make the world say wow.

Who we are

### If you're active, Strava was made for you. Our mobile app and website enhance the experience of
### sport and connect millions of athletes from around the world. We're the social network for those
### who strive. Join us.
* [Activity Summary]
  
  ### Start by sweating.
  
  The way you "post" in this network is by being active. Strava works with your mobile phone or
  favorite GPS device to track your activities and share your efforts with friends.
* [Analysis]
  
  ### Get *better* by analysis.
  
  When your workout is over, almost every metric you can imagine awaits - from basics like speed,
  pace and distance, to Strava exclusives, like your performance compared to past attempts and
  Relative Effort.
* [Training Log]
  
  ### Dive into details on desktop.
  
  Our desktop experience goes even deeper with training plans, route planning, activity breakdowns
  and other tools to take your planning and analysis game to the limit.

## Join for the tracking, stay for the community.

#### Open, tap, go.

Recording an activity with Strava is easy, and afterward you'll have a detailed activity map and
tons of performance data.

#### A no BS network.

The Strava feed is full of inspiring activities, crazy adventures and interesting new routes – all
the best athletic content, none of the junk posts you find on other social networks.

#### The ultimate athlete resource.

A running club in your neighborhood, content from your favorite bicycle maker, the best trail to
catch the sunset, a fun new race, the city's toughest climb, a weekend training partner - whatever
your next adventure, you'll find it on Strava.

#### Share & Connect

Workout with friends, stay motivated, get inspired - our community is what separates Strava from the
rest.

Discover your next goal with Strava segments, routes, maps, clubs, challenges and race courses.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Strava is Swedish for “strive,” which epitomizes who we are and what we do. We’re a passionate and committed team, unified by our mission to connect athletes to what motivates them and help them find their personal best. And with billions of activity uploads from all over the world, we have a humbling and audacious vision: to be the record of the world’s athletic activities and the technology that makes every effort count.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Suunto was founded in 1936 by Tuomas Vohlonen, a Finnish orienteer and inventor of the liquid-filled field compass. Since then Suunto has been at the forefront of design and innovation for sports watches, dive computers and instruments used by adventure seekers all over the globe. From the highest mountains to the deepest oceans, we inspire and equip active and adventurous lives. Suunto’s headquarters and manufacturing plant are in Vantaa, Finland. Employing approximately 500 people worldwide, Suunto products are sold in over 100 countries.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Withings created the first smart scale in 2009, and has been the pioneer in connected health ever since. Its clinically validated and multi-award winning range is used by millions worldwide, and includes smart scales, hybrid watches, blood pressure monitors, sleep analyzers and more. The team of engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals at Withings work alongside clinical experts to make it possible to take medical-grade measurements at home. Withings was the first to bring measurements for pulse wave velocity and electrodermal activity into the home – finding ever more precise ways to measure our health. Each device is designed to fit beautifully into daily life, supported by an app that unlocks long-term health insights and offers programs to create meaningful change. At Withings we’re dedicated to creating a world where people can see their path to better health, and feel supported to pursue it. Find out more at withings.com and connect with us on Facebook, Instagram or Twitter.

Xiaomi is a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core. Embracing our vision of “Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users’ hearts”, Xiaomi continuously pursues innovations, high-quality user experience and operational efficiency. The company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology. Xiaomi is one of the world's leading smartphone companies. In December 2025, global monthly active users ( "MAU") reached 754.1 million. The company has also established the world’s leading consumer AIoT (AI+IoT) platform, reached 1079.2 million smart devices connected to its platform (excluding smartphones, laptops and tablets) as of December 31, 2025. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world. In July 2025, Xiaomi was included in the Fortune Global 500 list for the seventh year in a row. Xiaomi is a constituent of the Hang Seng Index, Hang Seng China Enterprises Index, Hang Seng TECH Index and Hang Seng China 50 Index.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Zeblaze 2014 yılında Çin'in Shenzhen şehrinde kurulan, alanında öncü Giyilebilir Teknoloji markasıdır. 5 yıl içinde akıllı saat endüstrisi liderleri arasına katılan Zeblaze, bu dönemde piyasaya sunduğu birçok modelinin üstün kalitesi ve rekabetçi fiyatları sayesinde Asya pazarının en çok satan markası haline gelmiştir. Zeblaze markası, her bütçeye uygun, üstün performanslı akıllı saatleri ile 100’ün üzerinde ülkede satışa sunulmuştur. Zeblaze Türkiye olarak, insanların hayatlarını değiştirmeye yardımcı olan ürünler tasarlayan, spor ve sağlık için giyilebilir elektroniklere odaklanan dinamik bir ekibiz. Akıllı giyilebilir teknolojiler, veri aktarımı ve işlemedeki yeniliklerle insanların hayata bağlanma şeklini değiştiriyoruz!

# **about us***Come get to know us*

Shenzhen COLMI Technology Co., Ltd , established in 2012, is a high-tech company focusing on the R&D
and manufacturing of smart wearable products. 
We have more than 50 COLMI brand agents in more than 20countries. We are also the OEM and ODM
partner of well-known smart wearable brands in several countries.
At COLMI we don't think affordability and quality should be mutually exclusive. We are committed to
being as cost-effective as possible without sacrificing quality. That's why everything from our
design to manufacturing process is done with worker's care and attention to detail to ensure we
release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.
[view more ][133]

## Company development History

## 2024-Future

In 2024, COLMI began laying the foundation for global brand expansion.

## 2021-2022

In 2021, COLMI was awarded the National High-tech Enterprise certificate, which is an affirmation of
our technological innovation and R&D strength.


## 2019-2020

In 2019, COLMI embarked on a global electronics exhibition tour, showcasing our strength and vision
to the world.

## 2015-2018

In 2015, COLMI won recognition in the industry with its outstanding innovative design and was
awarded the Innovative Design Award.

## 2012-2014

In 2012, our factory and office were officially established, marking a solid first step for the
company.

**Are you a smartwatch manufacturer?**

**Do you offer [OEM and ODM customization][20]?**

customization.

**Which smartwatch models are designed for elderly monitoring?**

Our [elderly-care series includes][21] S3, F21 Pro, F800, featuring 4G LTE, GPS tracking, SOS
button, and fall detection.

**Do your smartwatches support 4G LTE and real-time GPS?**

Yes. Many models support [4G LTE, with GPS][22] + LBS + WiFi positioning for high-accuracy outdoor
and indoor tracking.

**Can you adjust frequency bands for different countries?**

Yes. We customize LTE bands for Asia, Europe, Africa, North & South America.

**Do your smartwatches have SOS emergency alerts?**

Yes. Our 4G GPS watches include a physical SOS button that sends instant alerts with real-time
location.

**What health-monitoring functions do you support?**

Features include [heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2][23], sleep tracking, and optional fall
detection.

**Are your smartwatches waterproof?**

Yes. Selected models are [IP67 or IP68 waterproof][24], suitable for daily use and showering.

**What is your MOQ for wholesale orders?**

[Standard models 10][25]–500 pcs, OEM logo 500–1000 pcs, full customization 1,000–3,000 pcs.

**Do you provide samples for testing?**

Yes. Samples are available for compatibility and performance evaluation before mass production.

**Which systems do your watches support?**

All watches [work with Android and iOS][26], and we offer cloud platforms for elderly monitoring and

## Consumer Electronics & IoT Devices

End-to-end hardware design and development, from schematics to PCB layout, ensuring high-performance
devices. Custom embedded software for seamless integration with Android, Linux, and RTOS. IoT device
management through a cloud-based dashboard for real-time monitoring, updates, and diagnostics.

[Untitled design (56).png]

## Reliable Play Out Monitoring Solutions

Inditronics' AI-powered monitoring solutions provide accurate content verification and seamless
broadcast tracking. With real-time monitoring, audio/video fingerprinting, and automated
verification, you gain full visibility and detailed insights. Backed by 99.9% uptime, 24/7 support,
and secure backups, our platform ensures reliability and performance.

[Learn More ][28]
[Untitled design (55).png]

## Industrial Automation & Smart Manufacturing

IoT-enabled industrial devices with smart sensors and controllers for real-time process monitoring
and efficiency optimization. AI and edge computing for predictive maintenance, real-time
decision-making, and automated system optimization. Cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and GCP for
seamless device management, data processing, and global scalability.

[Learn More ][29]

Audience measurement for TV, radio, YouTube, and gaming using audio and video fingerprinting,
watermarking, and AI-driven analytics. Track TRP, ad detection, audience engagement, and content
performance in real-time across broadcast and digital platforms. Cloud-based tools provide
predictive insights and reporting for smarter media strategies.

scripting automation to building custom dashboards for real-time insights, the Manager UI provides

## Shenzhen Jindou Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.: Global Experts in Smart Wearable Solutions

Established in 2012, SPALIY has grown to become a leading smartwatch manufacturer and supplier in
Shenzhen, China. We specialize in the R&D and production of high-quality 3C smart products,
including: Business Smartwatches: Designed for professionals, packed with powerful features. Women's
Health & Fitness Smartwatches: Blending elegant design with comprehensive health monitoring
capabilities. Fitness Tracker Smartwatches: Precisely recording activity data to support a healthy
lifestyle.

With a modern 20,000-square-meter production base and a professional team of over 200, we are a
trusted cooperative manufacturer for more than 520 international brands. Our smartwatches have been
successfully exported to over 40 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, North America, South
America, Australia, the Middle East, and Africa, delivering exceptional smart wearable experiences.

#### Advanced Manufacturing Power

Operating a 20,000㎡ modern production base in Shenzhen, we leverage state-of-the-art facilities and
a 200+ professional team to ensure high-capacity, consistent quality at scale.

#### 14+ Years of R&D Excellence

Since 2012, we have pioneered smart wearable technology, specializing in the R&D of high-quality 3C
products with multiple independently developed patented technologies.

#### Certified Global Quality

Our commitment to excellence is backed by international certifications including ISO, CE, RoHS, FCC,
and FDA, ensuring every smartwatch meets the highest safety and performance standards.

#### Professional OEM/ODM Solutions

As a trusted partner for 520+ international brands, we provide end-to-end custom manufacturing from
design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

Designed for athletes and gym-goers, our sports smartwatches feature 100+ sports modes, real-time
heart rate tracking, and calorie counting to elevate every workout.

and a sleek metal frame design for seamless professional connectivity.

### Comprehensive Health Monitoring

Ideal for proactive health management, providing 24/7 monitoring of blood pressure, SpO2, and sleep
patterns for the elderly and health-conscious users.

### Rugged Outdoor Exploration

Engineered for tough environments, featuring GPS smartwatches with IP68/5ATM waterproof ratings,
perfect for hiking, swimming, and extreme outdoor sports.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Exostretch is a Technology Transfer Start-Up, surrounding a patented thin-film, stretchable battery technology from the University of Houston's Division of Research. Exostretch consists of a management team: Ross Smolen, Akshay Joshi, Dat Vu, and Nathaniel Scott, Public Relations director: Triet Tran, and research team: Dr. Haleh Ardebili Ph.D., Dr. Mejdi Kammoun Ph.D., and Anujan Murugesu. Exostretch is advised by Mary Hakam and Mounir Zok. Mary Hakam is the president of Woodlands Textiles and has created technical textile clothing systems for NASA, WL Gore, and special operations forces. Mary Hakam is also a part of the Advanced Functional Fabrics Of America consortium, establishing standards for smart textiles. Mounir Zok is the director of technology and innovation for the United States Olympic Committee. Exostretch has competed in business plan competitions and has been the recipients of grants including: NASA iTech Program, Caltech FLoW competition, The National Science Foundation's (NSF) In-LA Blitz I-Corps program, Wolff Center for Entrepreneurship's internal competition, Baylor University New Venture competition, NSF Career grant, Texas space grant. Links to press: https://www.egr.uh.edu/news/201810/uh-startup-exostretch-powers-top-ten-finalist-position-battery-future https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sXKu0hwD2ME https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/spacetech/itech/Top_10_iTech_Finalists_Announced https://www.eenewsanalog.com/news/battery-startups-among-nasa-itech-finalists

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**

[Multiple PinePhones with different operating systems.]

The PINE64 community is large, vibrant and diverse. Independent and partner-project developers,

They all contribute to the project thereby shaping it and determining its course. This page is
community run, as is the Wiki, the chats as well as the forums.

## We understand that every step towards health and fitness should be simple and inspiring. That's
## why we created Gloox, a mobile fitness app where your comfort and freedom come first.

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.

- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.

FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Fastrack es la única solución del mercado, para crear y hacer crecer equipos de ventas de alto rendimiento, que integra en un solo servicio: Hiring, Entrenamiento con certificación en growth y Onboarding personalizado. Hemos creado lo que nos hubiera gustado tener, cuando gestionábamos grandes equipos comerciales y teníamos que enfrentarnos a los 3 retos con mayor impacto en el crecimiento: 1. Encontrar buenos perfiles comerciales. 2. Entrenarles y certificarles con una metodología 80% práctica, que es lo único que funciona de verdad. Todo lo demás NO tiene impacto. 3. Hacer un onboarding personalizado. Se suele abandonar al comercial a su suerte cuando se incorpora a la compañía, alargando los tiempos de tracción en el mejor de los casos.

# Notify for Smartwatches

Unleash the power of your smartwatch.

# Get your smartwatch

Don't have a smartwatch yet or is time to update your outdated band? Shop now new watches and
accessories.

[ Go to shop][8]
[picture]

## What's new

Check latest app new features and updates.

### About app

Get custom alerts on your smartwatch when you receive a new notification on your smartphone, you'll
never miss any call or your friends' messages.

Add all your reminders to never miss an important event.

Use the music player buttons to run custom actions like change music track, start voice assistant,
run an Alexa routine, reply to a Whatsapp/Telegram message, …

> Your privacy first! This app doesn't save your data on cloud and doesn't sell your data

[mobile-devices]

## All smartwatches supported

Notify app support any smartwatch model including: Amazfit, Mi Band, Xiaomi, Haylou, Honor, Samsung,
FitBit, TicWatch, Garmin, Huawei, Umidigi, Casio, Polar, ...

### Limited notifications official apps - [Mibro Fit][54], [QiFit][55], [Keep Health][56], ...

Receive notifications from all your favorite apps, even thos not officially supported by your
smartwatch. Notify special feature bridges the gap, offering you a comprehensive notification
solution for your limited, fixed-list of official app notifications.

[Open tutorial][57]

### ZeppOS apps

Dedicated Notify apps compatible with ZeppOS smartwatches: Amazfit GTR 3, Amazfit GTR 3 Pro, Amazfit

Join out community on Telegram to get additional help and submit your suggestions:
* [ Telegram ][61]

#### [ How to pair my watch with Notify App ][62]

[Check out the complete pairing tutorial][63]

#### [ How can I manage or stop the notifications I receive? ][64]

You can enable silent mode using the bell icon available on main screen or on the notification bar.

[Check out how to setup notifications][65]

#### [ Can I use the subscription on more than one device? ][66]

Yes, your license is linked to your Google account. If you use the same Google account on different
you don't have to buy license again. Family option is not available for in-app purchases, check
Google help for more details.

[More information about Notify license][67]

#### [ Notifications are not working ][68]

[How to setup notifications tutorial][69]

#### [ Watch is not connecting / data is not getting synced ][70]

[Check out the complete pairing tutorial][71]

#### [ Battery drain high usage ][72]

[How to reduce phone battery usage][73]

#### [ Unwanted notifications ][74]

[How to stop getting unwanted notifications][75]

## Discover Top Notify App Features

There are many interesting features available on Notify app. You can customize each feature on your
needs.

##### [Notifications][76]

Send custom notification to your watch, ignore unwanted notifications, send a reply to the messages
using your watch.

##### [Support][77]

Need help or want submite a new feature? Contact us, or join the Telegram official group.

##### [Tutorials][78]

List of tutorials to help you configure your smart watch.

[featuresapp]

##### [Reminders][79]

Setup your custom alarms and reminders to never miss an event such as a meeting, appointment,
medicine, ...

##### [Button][80]

Run custom button actions
Setup custom integrations using Tasker and similar app

##### [Tools][81]

There is no recurring monthly subscription fee.

## Pricing

**No recurring subscription.**
* FREE
* -
* **- Basic features**: notifications, reminders, ...
* PRO
* $3
* **Advanced features**: custom notifications, custom contacts, filters, do not disturb, ...

Get Your Instant & FREE Quotation here: Online: www.WeLoveWristbands.com Call: 01642 967 075 Email: sales@welovewristbands.com Here at #WeLoveWristbands, put very simply "You'll Find A Better Quality Wristband at Even Better Prices - GUARANTEED!"​ Whether you're event is large or small we can offer you Tyvek wristbands, fabric wristbands, and silicone wristbands for your Events & Venues. We can even help you with personalising them with our in-house graphic design service. Our top priority is to supply you with the best product and service, while keeping costs competitive, and you as a customer happy! With over a decade in the events industry we know exactly what is needed to keep things running smoothly. Need your #Wristbands fast? In some instances we can turn around your order in just 24 hours. You can rely on our expertise and efficiency when ordering your #wristbands with us. When we gain a client we like to keep them! We respect your privacy and you can trust that we will always have your best interests in mind. We are a design led company that always keeps your brand image in mind. In this case looks and first-impressions are important. We'll help you choose the right wristband for your event and we'll help you present your message clearly. We also offer a unique 'Supply & Apply service'​; Your company can benefit by taking the headache out of crowd management. We pride ourselves on delivery time, trust, helpfulness, quality products at great competitive prices. Contact us for a FREE wristband quote now! Call us for a free quotation - 01642 967 075 Email: sales@welovewristbands.com

_crawl.linkedin_about: For over 30 years, Mindteck has been the quiet engine behind breakthrough innovations in Life Sciences, Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Semiconductor, and Data Storage. From embedded systems to AI-driven platforms — we engineer what matters. Trusted by Fortune 1000 companies and ambitious startups alike, Mindteck delivers end-to-end product engineering and IT services across the full technology lifecycle — from concept and prototyping to manufacturing readiness and digital transformation. Our expertise spans: → AI & Data Services — LLM-based solutions, analytics, and intelligent automation → IoT & Embedded Systems — The Ignite platform for smart buildings, energy, and healthcare → Product Engineering — Hardware, firmware, and software for regulated industries → Quality Engineering & Testing — CMMI Level 5 processes with shift-left methodology → BPM Services — Domain-focused, outcome-driven operations for insurance, BFSI, and more Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, with offices across USA, UK, Canada, Germany, Singapore, Malaysia, Bahrain, and Philippines — we bring global scale with local expertise. Founding member of The Atlas of Economic Complexity at Harvard University's CID. Publicly listed on BSE & NSE. Mission Mindteck brings over 30 years of hands-on expertise in product engineering, embedded systems, AI, and enterprise data storage, including cloud-native storage platforms, distributed systems, and storage testing, to help clients across medical devices, semiconductors, life sciences, analytical instruments, energy utilities, manufacturing, and smart infrastructure build reliable products and systems, with the technical depth, rigorous process, and senior-level attention that complex engineering demands. Vision To be the engineering and technology partner that global innovators trust when the work is complex, the stakes are high, and execution cannot fail.

_crawl.linkedin_about: P A Time Industries, with a legacy of over 50 years in the Wrist Watch and Watch Spare business, Created Brands like Maxima, Ego, Max-Pro Smart Watches and Premium Maxima Plus Watches. The Journey Started in 1962, When Mr. GS Purewal, Chairman, P.A. Group, had set up P A Pinions, One of the largest manufacturing facility for watch spares, this continued with Purewal & Associates and Now with P A Time Industries which manufactures electronic watch components and quartz wrist watches. P A Time Industries launched MAXIMA, its flagship brand in the 90s, this brand went on to become hugely popular with its unique patented waterproof technology products. The success of its single point communication of being “India's first guaranteed waterproof watch at Rs.350” created a history of sorts and established the brand among a large consumer base across the country. MAXIMA was the result of a vision to serve a vast majority of consumers through products that were accurate, reliable, guaranteed for quality and backed by after sales service with a trusted brand assurance. Today Brand MAXIMA is known for its contemporary product designs, youthful product styling, and value pricing. It has a large range of products consisting Metal Analogue Watches, Plastic and Fiber Analogue Watches, Digital Watches, Analogue-Digital Watches, Chronograph-Multifunction series of watches and Designer Watches. MAXIMA Offers one-year product warranty on its products and 100% replacement guarantee on defects in waterproof watches. With sleek designs, high product standards and affordable pricing, the brand have seen massive acceptability in the mind of consumers. MAXIMA can be seen available in every part of the country with the support of over 75 plus distributors/Partner, 5000 Plus loyal retailers and various e-commerce platforms like Flipkart, Amazon, Paytm, Jabong, Limeroad etc. Brand’s massive collection is backed by excellent after sales service across the country.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Watteco is a French company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and commercialization of data measurement sensors. These sensors transmit data over long-range, low-bandwidth, and low-power radio networks (LPWAN), including both private and public LoRaWAN infrastructures. With recognized expertise in the design, development, industrialization, and production of electronic devices, Watteco addresses key segments of the Internet of Things (IoT) market: Smart Industry, Smart Building, Smart City, and Smart Metering. The company also provides advanced solutions compliant with ATEX standards, suitable for use in hazardous and explosive environments. Driven by a constant commitment to meeting our customers' needs, Watteco supports its clients throughout every stage of their project—from identifying use cases and recommending appropriate solutions, to training, installation support, and commissioning. To simplify the deployment of our sensors, we’ve developed a comprehensive set of tools, including user guides, video tutorials, a dedicated support website, and more. Our product portfolio continues to expand to meet evolving industry demands and new use cases.

## Everything You Need to Know About Our Services

Get answers to the most common questions about Technical Sewa's professional technical services,
repairs, and maintenance solutions.

### 1What services does Technical Sewa provide?

Technical Sewa offers comprehensive technical services including appliance repair (AC, refrigerator,
washing machine, etc.), maintenance contracts (AMC), technical training courses, on-site support,
and emergency repair services.

We cover all major brands and provide doorstep service across Nepal with certified technicians and
genuine spare parts.

### 2Which areas do you serve for doorstep service?

We provide doorstep technical services across major cities in Nepal including Kathmandu, Lalitpur,
Bhaktapur, Pokhara, Biratnagar, and surrounding areas.

Our technicians are available 24/7 for emergency repairs and scheduled maintenance services
throughout the region.

### 3How quickly can you respond to service requests?

We guarantee doorstep repair service within 3 hours for urgent cases. For regular maintenance and
non-emergency repairs, we typically respond within 24 hours.

Our emergency hotline is available 24/7 for immediate assistance and critical technical support.

### 4What warranty do you provide on repairs?

We provide 1 year warranty on all repairs and services. This covers both labor and genuine spare
parts.

For AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) customers, we offer extended warranty benefits and priority
service support.

### 5How much do your services cost?

Our services start from NPR 500 for basic repairs. Pricing varies based on the type of appliance,
complexity of the issue, and parts required.

We offer free quotes and transparent pricing with no hidden charges. AMC packages provide
cost-effective long-term solutions.

### 6Are your technicians qualified and certified?

Yes, all our technicians are fully trained, certified, and experienced professionals. They receive
regular training on latest technologies and safety protocols.

Our team includes certified professionals for specific brands and specialized equipment to ensure
quality service.

### 7What are the benefits of AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)?

AMC provides regular maintenance, priority service, discounted repair rates, free emergency calls,
and extended warranty coverage.

It helps prevent major breakdowns, saves money in the long run, and ensures your appliances run
efficiently throughout the year.

### 8Do you provide emergency service outside business hours?

Absolutely! We provide 24/7 emergency technical support. Our emergency hotline is always active, and
we have technicians on standby for urgent repairs.

Emergency service is available for critical issues that cannot wait until regular business hours.

## Q&A

### Is MyFitnessPal a free calorie tracker app?

Yes! If you're looking for a free calorie counter app, you're in the right place. Simply [sign up
for your free account][6] here and start tracking your food.

The MyFitnessPal app does a lot more than track calories in foods. You can also track macros,
vitamins, and other micronutrients and see how everything you eat supports your goals.

**Want to level up your goals? Upgrade to Premium!** Unlock MyFitnessPal's best tools (like Barcode
Scan, Intermittent Fasting, and Custom Macro Goals).

If you've never upgraded to MyFitnessPal Premium or never started a Premium trial before, you are
eligible for a 7-day free trial. [Start your free trial now.][7]

The first Premium subscription charge on your credit card will be after the trial. Once the trial
ends, your subscription will auto-renew unless you cancel. If you purchased a monthly subscription,
you will be charged every month. If you purchased an annual subscription, you will be charged every
year.

You may cancel your recurring subscription at any time. Cancel at least 24 hours before the next
renewal date to avoid being charged for the upcoming billing cycle. When you cancel, you are
canceling the next billing charge—Premium features will remain available to you until the end of
your current paid subscription period, regardless of when you cancel the automatic renewal.

### How to track calories with a calorie counter app like MyFitnessPal?

If you want to know how many calories are in the foods you eat, or how many calories you eat each
day, the MyFitnessPal app makes it easy.

[Sign up for a free account][8] and download the app. Then you can quickly look up calories and
nutrients for any food AND track it all to see the impact of food on your health and fitness goals.

Free members can do a simple food search from their app's home screen. Premium members have access
to other time-saving tools that allow you to scan a barcode or individual foods with your phone's
camera to instantly identify the best match. [Learn more about Premium and try it free][9].

However you choose to look up calories for foods, MyFitnessPal gives you access to over 18 million
global foods in one of the world's largest food databases — including fresh foods, packaged goods,
restaurant items, and even foods and recipes you save yourself.

### What nutrition data can I track besides calories?

MyFitnessPal isn't just a calorie tracking app. We're a macro tracking app, a micronutrient tracking
app, and a water tracking app — all in one! (Not to mention the other goals you can track, including
weight, exercise, steps, and intermittent fasting.)

The Signatur Collection

Characterized by clean lines, uncluttered dials, and artful use of negative space, this bestselling
platform encapsulates modern style and Scandinavian minimalism by elevating detailing in its
simplest form.

[Shop His][137] [Shop Hers][138]
[feature of gun mellem]
[Shop Mellem][139]

The Mellem Collection

The Mellem embodies minimalist design by striking a perfect balance between geometric forms. Its
sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]
[feature of pearls jewelry]
[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

# Community-Powered Motivation

[Join Us Now][24]

Explore Strava

Who we are

### If you're active, Strava was made for you. Our mobile app and website enhance the experience of
### sport and connect millions of athletes from around the world. We're the social network for those
### who strive. Join us.
* [Activity Summary]
  
  ### Start by sweating.
  
  The way you "post" in this network is by being active. Strava works with your mobile phone or
  favorite GPS device to track your activities and share your efforts with friends.
* [Analysis]
  
  ### Get *better* by analysis.
  
  When your workout is over, almost every metric you can imagine awaits - from basics like speed,
  pace and distance, to Strava exclusives, like your performance compared to past attempts and
  Relative Effort.
* [Training Log]
  
  ### Dive into details on desktop.
  
  Our desktop experience goes even deeper with training plans, route planning, activity breakdowns
  and other tools to take your planning and analysis game to the limit.

## Join for the tracking, stay for the community.

#### Open, tap, go.

Recording an activity with Strava is easy, and afterward you'll have a detailed activity map and
tons of performance data.

#### A no BS network.

The Strava feed is full of inspiring activities, crazy adventures and interesting new routes – all
the best athletic content, none of the junk posts you find on other social networks.

#### The ultimate athlete resource.

A running club in your neighborhood, content from your favorite bicycle maker, the best trail to
catch the sunset, a fun new race, the city's toughest climb, a weekend training partner - whatever
your next adventure, you'll find it on Strava.

## Explore our features.

#### Track & Analyze

Learn about recording an activity on Strava and all the ways you can analyze your performance.

#### Share & Connect

Workout with friends, stay motivated, get inspired - our community is what separates Strava from the
rest.

#### Explore & Compete

Discover your next goal with Strava segments, routes, maps, clubs, challenges and race courses.

# IoT Products 
# for all needs

[Energy grid and Photovoltaic][64]
[Industry and Automation][65]
[Public Information System][66]
[Street light systems][67]
[Traffic Managment][68]
[Parking Management][69]

Atreyo designs and manufactures industrial IoT and embedded systems for automation, monitoring, and
control applications. Since 2016, we have been providing reliable products such as  sensors,
communication devices, display units, and custom electronics for various industries.
With in-house R&D, firmware development, and manufacturing, we ensure consistent quality and
support. Our solutions are used in utilities, transportation, energy, and infrastructure projects
where reliability and long-term availability are important.
*  
  
  ## AG-702
  
  ### OpenWRT LTE IoT programmable gateway with RS485, RS232 and I/O
  * **OpenWRT system with custom script support**
  * **Dual Ethernet, WiFi, 4G LTE, GPS and isolated RS485 and RS232**
  * **Additional 512MB memory as overlay**
  * **More than 6000 ready applications**
  
  [Know more][70]
  [AG-702]
*  
  
  ### Smart Street Light
  
  The Atreyo Smart Street Light System is an IoT technology system that completely manage street
  light with hardware support. The system controls each individual luminaire from the server based
  application. The  system is an advanced web application specially adapted for comprehensive
  lighting management.
  
  [Know more][71]
  [Smart light]
*  
  
  ## AG-1629
  
  ### Industrial computer - cellular gateway
  * **Linux operating system**
  * **Dual Ethernet, dual isolated RS485**
  * **Dual SIM, WiFi, LTE, Bluetooth and digital inputs and outputs**
  * **Small size, passive cooling**
  
  [Know more][72]
  [AG-1629 IoT Gateway]
*  
  
  ## AG-743
  
  #### 4G LTE 4 Ethernet industrial router
  * OpenWRT system with custom script support
  * 1x WAN 3x LAN, WiFi, 4G LTE, GPS and isolated RS485
  * Additional 512MB memory as overlay
  * More than 6500 ready applications
  
  [Know more][73]
  [AG-1629 IoT Gateway]

[reliable icon]

### Reliable

All the products developed at atreyo are industrial grade and capable of withstanding harsh
environments.

[secure -icon]

### Secure

By the use of the latest digital technologies, our IoT devices provide a high level of data
security.

[easy icon]

### Easy to use

The user interface is very important. We use the latest and convenient solutions to make
configuration and management as easy as possible.

## Solutions that Simplify
* ### Atra-RMS
  
  ATRA-RMS is a dedicated component of the Atra IoT platform, designed to streamline the management
  and monitoring of IoT devices.
   
  
  [Know more][74]
   
*  
  
  ### Smart Street Light
  
  The Atreyo Smart Street Light System is an IoT technology system that completely manage street
  light with hardware support. The system controls each individual luminaire from the server based
  application. The main benefits is saving of electricity consumption.
  
  [Know more][75]

# **about us***Come get to know us*

Shenzhen COLMI Technology Co., Ltd , established in 2012, is a high-tech company focusing on the R&D
and manufacturing of smart wearable products. 
We have more than 50 COLMI brand agents in more than 20countries. We are also the OEM and ODM
partner of well-known smart wearable brands in several countries.
At COLMI we don't think affordability and quality should be mutually exclusive. We are committed to
being as cost-effective as possible without sacrificing quality. That's why everything from our
design to manufacturing process is done with worker's care and attention to detail to ensure we
release only the most premium finished products on the market. We hope to use our more than ten
years of industry-leading experience to help you succeed in the smart wearable market.
[view more ][133]

## Company development History

## 2024-Future

In 2024, COLMI began laying the foundation for global brand expansion.

## 2021-2022

In 2021, COLMI was awarded the National High-tech Enterprise certificate, which is an affirmation of
our technological innovation and R&D strength.


## 2019-2020

In 2019, COLMI embarked on a global electronics exhibition tour, showcasing our strength and vision
to the world.

## 2015-2018

In 2015, COLMI won recognition in the industry with its outstanding innovative design and was
awarded the Innovative Design Award.

## 2012-2014

In 2012, our factory and office were officially established, marking a solid first step for the
company.

No company can realize the IoT on its own… Within the Eclipse Community, through the contribution of
many IoT developers, tools and standards are created on an open platform that many companies can
benefit from for their IoT applications.

[Picture of Stefan Ferber]

Stefan Ferber / Co-CEO and CTO, Bosch .IO GmbH

Eclipse IoT is the industry’s leading community for Open Source IoT projects. For Red Hat, Eclipse
IoT is the place where we collaborate with like-minded colleagues from other firms to create
projects that form the basis of our IoT products.

[Picture of David Ingham]

David Ingham / Director of Software Engineering, Integration Middleware, Red Hat

Within Eclipse IoT, Eurotech is working with Cloudera, Red Hat, and others to develop key IoT

architectures.

Finally, DB foresees more open source integrations in the future and looks forward to collaborating
within the Eclipse IoT Working Group. Being part of a collaboration like Eclipse IoT is a good
opportunity to improve DB’s use of open source technology, and in the long term creates better
solutions for DB passengers.

[Picture of Alexander Schmitt]

The Eclipse Foundation [puts] forth great effort to provide open source contributions in the IoT
space, which translates to vitality and enthusiasm. This is very important to us.

computing, automotive, and more. We are a not-for-profit organization supported by over 300 members.

No company can realize the IoT on its own… Within the Eclipse Community, through the contribution of
many IoT developers, tools and standards are created on an open platform that many companies can
benefit from for their IoT applications.

[Picture of Stefan Ferber]

Stefan Ferber / Co-CEO and CTO, Bosch .IO GmbH

Eclipse IoT is the industry’s leading community for Open Source IoT projects. For Red Hat, Eclipse
IoT is the place where we collaborate with like-minded colleagues from other firms to create
projects that form the basis of our IoT products.

[Picture of David Ingham]

David Ingham / Director of Software Engineering, Integration Middleware, Red Hat

Within Eclipse IoT, Eurotech is working with Cloudera, Red Hat, and others to develop key IoT
runtimes and other enabling technologies that will enable integrated, end-to-end open IoT
architectures.

[Picture of Giuseppe Surace]

Finally, DB foresees more open source integrations in the future and looks forward to collaborating
within the Eclipse IoT Working Group. Being part of a collaboration like Eclipse IoT is a good
opportunity to improve DB’s use of open source technology, and in the long term creates better
solutions for DB passengers.

[Picture of Alexander Schmitt]

Alexander Schmitt / Chief Architect, DB-Systel

The Eclipse Foundation [puts] forth great effort to provide open source contributions in the IoT
space, which translates to vitality and enthusiasm. This is very important to us.

## Eclipse Foundation

The Eclipse Foundation provides individuals and organizations with a business-friendly environment
for open source software collaboration and innovation. The Foundation is home to the Eclipse IDE,
Jakarta EE, and over 375 projects, including runtimes, tools, and frameworks for IoT, edge
computing, automotive, and more. We are a not-for-profit organization supported by over 300 members.
Learn more at [eclipse.org.][19]

Workouts with a locked screen

about us

## We understand that every step towards health and fitness should be simple and inspiring. That's
## why we created Gloox, a mobile fitness app where your comfort and freedom come first.

Fitness has become easier
Our app supports smartwatch operation to make your workouts even more effective.
Now you can monitor your progress at any time.
Access to ready-made training plans
If you don't want to waste time developing your programs, choose from a variety of ready-made
training plans created by professional trainers.
Individual approach to training
Change your training plans at any time. Your goals, schedule, and training level may change, and our
service allows you to adjust your program without unnecessary difficulties.
Your workouts — your way
Build your own programs or choose from ready-made plans.
Ai nutritionist
- Personal recommendations: Takes into account goals, preferences and allergies.
- Diet Tracking: Daily nutrition correction tips.
Ai coach
- Personalized plans: Takes into account the level, goals and preferences.
- Progress analysis: Tracking and recommendations for improvement.
Ai doctor
- Analysis and recommendations: Improves well-being in real time.
- Prevention and diagnosis: Indicates risks and suggests measures in advance.
Ai assistant
- Organization of the day:
Helps you plan your workouts, work, and vacations effectively.
- Reminders:
Notifies you about workouts, meals, and medical checkups.
Your coach, always with you
Get smart guidance and personalised plans from your AI coach.
Increased power and speed
Alternating between exercise and rest contributes to the development of strength and speed.
Improvement of the cardiovascular system
Interval training stimulates the heart and increases lung capacity.
Increased metabolism
An increased metabolic rate after exercise helps burn calories even at rest.
Effective calorie burning
Intense exercise allows you to achieve a calorie deficit faster, contributing to weight loss.
Boost your endurance
Interval training designed for maximum effectiveness.
Increasing the effectiveness of training
The analysis of daily results allows you to optimize workouts and increase their effect.
Visualizing progress
Graphs and infographics make it easy to assess changes in results and achievements.
More precise planning
Users can adjust their fitness goals and plans based on detailed data from previous sessions.
Motivation
Visual representation of data serves as a motivator and allows users to see real improvements.
Track your progress day by day
Detailed daily reports help you see your growth, step by step.
This is a section with frequently asked questions and answers. Popular user questions are collected
here so that you can easily understand all the nuances of usage.
FAQ
What workouts are available in the app?
The app offers workouts for various fitness levels: cardio, strength training, yoga, stretching, and
much more.
Is it necessary to purchase a paid subscription?
Basic features are free. A subscription is required for access to advanced workouts and personalized
programs.
Can I track my results?
Yes, the app automatically tracks your progress, the number of workouts completed, calories burned,
and achievements.
Does the app support creating a personalized plan?
Yes, the app creates a personalized workout plan based on your goals and parameters.
What devices are supported?
The app is available for iOS and Android smartphones. Some features can connect to fitness bands and
smartwatches.
Can workouts be done offline without internet access?
Yes, many workouts and plans can be downloaded in advance and used without an internet connection.
Your progress will sync when the internet is available again.

Hiotron, FactoryMetrics (a proprietary end-to-end Industry 4.0 platform) that combines plug-and-play

machine to customer, transforming manufacturing operations with intelligent, real-time insights that

## Successful Case Study : Where Technology Meets Real-World Impact

#### Rico Auto Industries Ltd – BMW Export lines Traceability System

## Project Overview

Rico Auto, a global Tier-1 partner for **BMW**, faced a critical mandate for its Gen-6 high-volume
export lines. In the high-precision automotive world, passing an OEM audit is not just about having
data; it’s about proving a “Digital Thread”—a seamless link between every machining parameter and
the final dispatched part.

## Business Challenge

Before Hiotron’s intervention, traceability relied on a “Fragmented Reality”:
1. **Data Silos:** Important information was spread across paper records, machine PLC data, and
   manual quality logs. Because the data was stored in different places, it was difficult to get one
   clear view of operations.
2. **Time-Consuming Audit Preparation: **Preparing for BMW audits took several days because teams
   had to manually collect and match records from different sources. This made the audit process
   slow, stressful, and resource-heavy.
3. **Risk of Wrong Parts Moving Forward: **Without real-time quality checks and interlocks, there
   was always a chance that a non-compliant part could move to the next stage because of human
   error. This created a serious quality and compliance risk.
4. **Limited Real-Time Traceability: **Operators, supervisors & managers did not have instant
   visibility into the journey of each component. As a result, tracking part status and identifying
   issues quickly was difficult.
5. **Weak Process Discipline at Scale: **Quality teams needed faster access to OK and NG status
   linked to each uniquely serialized part. Management also needed a reliable digital audit trail
   that could be reviewed easily, without depending on manual records. The plant required stronger
   process discipline to ensure that non-compliant parts were stopped before moving ahead.

## Hiotron Solution

Hiotron implemented an end-to-end QR and DPM scanner based part traceability solution tailored for
the **BMW** Gen-6 export lines. Each component was assigned a unique identity, and station-level
events were captured against that identity throughout the production journey.
1. **End-to-end part traceability:** Hiotron built a complete digital traceability system that
   tracked every part across the full production journey.
2. **Unique QR-based identity for every part:** Each component was linked to a unique QR code,
   making it easy to trace its status, history, and movement at any stage.
3. **Critical process and quality data capture:** The system captured important process parameters
   and quality data at every key stage and linked them to each part’s QR journey.
4. **Stage-wise interlocking for quality control:** Hiotron implemented interlocking at every stage
   so that if a part was marked **NG** or the correct process sequence was not followed, it could
   not move forward.
5. **Real-time visibility and OEE monitoring:** Operators, supervisors, and management gained live
   visibility into machine performance, production flow, and OEE for faster decision-making.
6. **One-click report export:** Part-wise, shift-wise, daily, and monthly reports could be generated
   and exported instantly, giving Rico as well as BMW audit teams a complete picture of operations
   and quality performance in just single click
7. **Stronger process discipline and audit readiness:** The solution created a reliable digital
   trail for every part, reduced manual dependency, and made audit preparation faster, easier, and
   more accurate.

# We believe the Internet changes lives.

## But only when people can access, trust, and use it safely.

[a dynamic collage of images, showcasing a blend of colors and themes]

## We believe the Internet changes lives.

## But only when people can access, trust, and use it safely.

## **We’re working to connect more than 2 billion people worldwide who are still offline, and make
## the Internet safer and more trustworthy. **

[**Learn About Our Work**][33]
[Participants at a community networks training from the Haiti Chapter stand outside]
[A group of girls sitting on a sidewalk with a woman in the middle holding laptop]

### 2025 Annual Report

### 2025 Annual Report

**In 2025, we worked in 150 countries and territories, supporting community-centered connectivity
initiatives, helping safeguard the multistakeholder model of Internet governance, scaling our
philanthropic impact through new funding partnerships, and so much more.**

The report outlines how our global community rose to the challenge of our ambitious five-year
strategy to expand affordable, reliable access and ensure that people everywhere are safe and secure
online.

[**Read Our Report**][34]
[[Three women sit on the grass outside]][35]

### [Community-Centered Connectivity Initiatives Earn Viddy Awards Recognition][36]

**Our global community works tirelessly to expand connectivity, educate users, and build the
Internet we want—an Internet for everyone. **

We are proud to share that four videos highlighting community initiatives have won Viddy Awards this
year.
[[People stand outdoors celebrating the completion of the Internet hub in the Siripi zone, waving at
the camera.]][37]

### [From Email to Case Study: What We Learned About Connecting Refugee Communities in Just One
### Year ][38]

**In Uganda’s Rhino Camp Refugee Settlement, we helped train refugees and community members to use
the Internet and build their own networks. **

Now, two fully operational, community-owned digital hubs serve over 4,500 people.
[[A graphic showing an email notification]][39]

### [Anatomy of a Scam][40]

**Online scams are at an all-time high, and digital tools have enabled them to become more
sophisticated, more convincing, and more widespread. **

Luckily, with the right information, you can learn how to identify online scams and keep yourself
safe. Let’s take a look at some common warning signs.
[**Read Our Blog**][41]

### 2025 Annual Report

### 2025 Annual Report

**In 2025, we worked in 150 countries and territories, supporting community-centered connectivity
initiatives, helping safeguard the multistakeholder model of Internet governance, scaling our
philanthropic impact through new funding partnerships, and so much more.**

The report outlines how our global community rose to the challenge of our ambitious five-year
strategy to expand affordable, reliable access and ensure that people everywhere are safe and secure
online.

[**Read Our Report**][34]
[[Three women sit on the grass outside]][35]

### [Community-Centered Connectivity Initiatives Earn Viddy Awards Recognition][36]

**Our global community works tirelessly to expand connectivity, educate users, and build the
Internet we want—an Internet for everyone. **

We are proud to share that four videos highlighting community initiatives have won Viddy Awards this
year.
[[People stand outdoors celebrating the completion of the Internet hub in the Siripi zone, waving at
the camera.]][37]

### [From Email to Case Study: What We Learned About Connecting Refugee Communities in Just One
### Year ][38]

**In Uganda’s Rhino Camp Refugee Settlement, we helped train refugees and community members to use
the Internet and build their own networks. **

Now, two fully operational, community-owned digital hubs serve over 4,500 people.

**Online scams are at an all-time high, and digital tools have enabled them to become more
sophisticated, more convincing, and more widespread. **

Luckily, with the right information, you can learn how to identify online scams and keep yourself
safe. Let’s take a look at some common warning signs.

range covers kids GPS watches, senior health watches, fitness trackers, and more. From our factory

In Defense and Medical fields, data accuracy is not an option—it is a necessity. We don’t just
assemble watches; we architect the hardware from the chip level to ensure 100% reliability in
extreme conditions.

We use a high-performance 4G chipset for data transmission and a low-power MCU for 24/7 sensing.
Result: Real-time clinical data with an ultra-long 15-day battery life.

#### Raw Data Integrity

Clinical-grade pressure sensors (±3mmHg error) and 250Hz ECG raw data output. Result: We provide
pure, unedited data for your institutional research and algorithms.

Aerospace titanium body with Mohs 9 Sapphire glass. Built to GJB (Military) standards and 10ATM
waterproof. Result: Zero deformation under high pressure. Your data stays safe in any environment.

  LoRaWAN technology, including those for temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, human
  presence, and many.
  [Explore Now ][77]
* [FindMy Tag]
  [FindMy logo]
  
  ### FindMy Tag
  
  Leveraging Bluetooth positioning technology, a Bluetooth FindMy tag supports Apple FindMy service
  to locate and track personal items, pets, and even personnel. These portable, lightweight trackers
  easily attach to various items without adding noticeable weight.
  [Explore Now ][78]
* [Repeater]
  
  ### Repeater
  
  A Bluetooth repeater continuously scans its environment for beacon signals, employs an advanced
  filtering algorithm to select the strongest signal, then transmits the MAC address and RSSI data
  to a gateway.
  [Explore Now ][79]
* [IoT Gateway]
  
  ### IoT Gateway
  
  IoT gateways (typically BLE/Wi-Fi gateway and LoRaWAN gateway) bridge the gap between different
  IoT devices and networks. They wirelessly or via wired connections collect data from sensors and
  smart devices, then communicate with cloud platforms.
  [Explore Now ][80]

The **ROCKPro64** features a Rockchip RK3399 hexa-core SoC.

## Quartz64 Model B

The **Quartz64 Model B** is powered by a Rockchip RK3566 quad-core ARM Cortex A55 64-Bit Processor
with a Mali G-52 GPU.


[View the details][11]
[Star64 featuring RISC-V]

## Star64 featuring RISC-V

The **Star64** is PINE64's first RISC-V SBC. It comes with a StarFive JH7110 64bit CPU sporting quad
SiFive FU740 cores clocked at 1.5GHz.


[View the details][12]
[Ox64]

## Ox64

The **Ox64** is a RISC-V based Single Board Computer powered by Bouffalo Lab BL808 C906 64-Bit
RISC-V CPU. It offers Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and ZigBee connectivity.


[View the details][13]
[Pinecil]

## Pinecil

The **Pinecil** is a smart mini portable soldering iron with a 32-bit RISC-V SoC featuring a sleek
design, auto standby and it heats up to an operating temperature in just 6 seconds!


[View the details][14]
[PinePhone and PinePhone Pro]

## PinePhone and PinePhone Pro

The **PinePhone** and **PinePhone Pro** are the two mainline Linux smartphones from PINE64.


[View the details][15]
[Various PineTabs]

## Various PineTabs

The **PineTab**, **PineTab2** and **PineTab-V** are the Linux tablet computers from PINE64 featuring
a detachable keyboard.


[View the details][16]
[PineNote]

## PineNote

The **PineNote** is the first hybrid notepad computer device combination of notebook, tablet and
e-reader using an e-ink panel.


[View the details][17]
[PineTime]

## PineTime

The **PineTime** is a free and open source smartwatch capable of running custom-built open operating
systems.


[View the details][18]

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**

[Multiple PinePhones with different operating systems.]

The PINE64 community is large, vibrant and diverse. Independent and partner-project developers,
hackers and hardware enthusiasts, privacy advocates and FOSS geeks - you name it, we’ve got ’em all.

They all contribute to the project thereby shaping it and determining its course. This page is
community run, as is the Wiki, the chats as well as the forums.

provide **high-performance NXP ARM® processing power** designed for rugged industrial embedded
applications, making them a reliable foundation for IoT solutions – from transportation and energy
to smart city deployments.

Industrial Single Board Computers

### GW16168 Edge AI Accelerator for Gateworks Industrial SBCs

The **GW16168** is an M.2 AI accelerator card designed to add powerful edge AI processing to
Gateworks industrial SBCs. Powered by the **NXP ARA240 Neural Processing Unit**, it delivers up to
**40 eTOPS** of AI performance for real-time workloads such as machine vision, robotics, and
predictive maintenance. With **16GB LPDDR4 memory** and a standard **M.2 PCIe interface**, it
enables efficient deployment of AI models directly on embedded and industrial IoT devices.

[Buy the GW16168 now][14]
Industrial Single Board Computers

### GW16167 802.11ah
### Wi-Fi HaLow M.2 Radio

The GW16167 is an 802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow M.2 card designed for long-range, reliable IoT connectivity
on Gateworks industrial SBCs. Operating in the 850–950 MHz band, it supports data rates up to 43.3
Mbps and transmit power up to +26 dBm, enabling extended coverage and strong signal penetration
through walls and industrial environments. Powered by the Morse Micro MM8108 chipset, it provides
stable, low-power wireless communication for demanding IoT and embedded applications.

# SPALIY: Leading Smartwatch Manufacturer, 14 Years Focused on Health, Fitness & Smart Wearables

As a core smartwatch supplier in Shenzhen, SPALIY offers a full range of smart wearable devices,
from fitness tracker smartwatches to business smartwatches. We provide comprehensive OEM/ODM
customization services, with products exported globally, making us your trusted smartwatch factory.

## Shenzhen Jindou Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.: Global Experts in Smart Wearable Solutions

Established in 2012, SPALIY has grown to become a leading smartwatch manufacturer and supplier in
Shenzhen, China. We specialize in the R&D and production of high-quality 3C smart products,
including: Business Smartwatches: Designed for professionals, packed with powerful features. Women's
Health & Fitness Smartwatches: Blending elegant design with comprehensive health monitoring
capabilities. Fitness Tracker Smartwatches: Precisely recording activity data to support a healthy
lifestyle.

With a modern 20,000-square-meter production base and a professional team of over 200, we are a
trusted cooperative manufacturer for more than 520 international brands. Our smartwatches have been
successfully exported to over 40 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, North America, South
America, Australia, the Middle East, and Africa, delivering exceptional smart wearable experiences.

#### Advanced Manufacturing Power

Operating a 20,000㎡ modern production base in Shenzhen, we leverage state-of-the-art facilities and
a 200+ professional team to ensure high-capacity, consistent quality at scale.

#### 14+ Years of R&D Excellence

Since 2012, we have pioneered smart wearable technology, specializing in the R&D of high-quality 3C
products with multiple independently developed patented technologies.

#### Certified Global Quality

Our commitment to excellence is backed by international certifications including ISO, CE, RoHS, FCC,
and FDA, ensuring every smartwatch meets the highest safety and performance standards.

#### Professional OEM/ODM Solutions

As a trusted partner for 520+ international brands, we provide end-to-end custom manufacturing from
design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

## See SPALIY Smart Watches in Action

### Experience the SPALIY Difference

Watch how our 20,000+ sqm smart watch facility delivers exceptional OEM/ODM results.Our advanced R&D
and automated production lines ensure consistent quality, on-time delivery,and competitive pricing
for global brand partners.
* Fully automated SMT production lines with 200,000+ monthly capacity
* 6-step QC process with 48-hour aging test on every unit
* One-stop OEM/ODM service from ID design to mass production
* Low MOQ from 50 pcs with CE, FCC, RoHS, GS, FDA certified

## Versatile Application Areas

### Professional Sports & Fitness

Designed for athletes and gym-goers, our sports smartwatches feature 100+ sports modes, real-time
heart rate tracking, and calorie counting to elevate every workout.

# The forefrontof innovation

Let's Work Together
[Abbott logo][The New York Times logo][The Knot logo][XO Group logo]

We help businesses of all shapes and sizes create inspiring software solutions.

[UX / UI Design]

#### UX / UI Design

We create experiences that are intuitive to use and visually appealing. From information
architecture to user flows and branding, our design team can handle the all aspects of product
design.

what we do

## Our specialties

[Product Strategy]

#### Product Strategy

Product strategy is our core competency, and we will partner with you from start to finish. We
believe products should be built iteratively, and will help you craft strategic MVPs, measure
analytics, and incorporate user feedback pre and post launch.

[Learn More][4]
[User Research & Testing]

#### User Research & Testing

We never release a product without gathering both qualitative and quantitative user feedback. From
moderated and unmoderated user interviews to usability testing, we ensure that our products always
meet the needs of the end user.

[Learn More][5]
[Full Stack Development]

#### Full Stack Development

We build disruptive web and hybrid mobile applications for software companies. We will carefully
match your unique needs to our team of experienced full stack developers.

[Learn More][6]
[Project Management]

#### Project Management

Our leadership team and project managers will work with you to ensure all projects meet the highest
quality standards and are completed on time and on budget.

[Learn More][7]
[Quality Assurance]

#### Quality Assurance

Nothing goes out the door until we put it through a vigorous QA process performed by our in-house
quality assurance testers.

## Nos **capteurs**

besoins !


### LoRaWAN

Notre large gamme de capteurs connectés exploitent la technologie radio du réseau LoRaWAN® pour de
nombreuses applications, notamment pour le bâtiment.


### BoB Assistant / Movee

BoB Assistant est une technologie de maintenance prédictive et d’assistance opérationnelle qui
surveille en continu les vibrations et les températures enregistrées des systèmes isolés (pompes,
unités de climatisation, unités de refroidissement, ventilateurs, etc.).


### Sur mesure

Notre bureau d’études se mobilise pour votre projet et conçoit votre future application adaptée à
vos besoins et usages.

optimiser vos performances industrielles ? Que ce soit pour améliorer la qualité de vie dans vos
bâtiments, digitaliser votre exploitation agricole ou monitorer vos installations ferroviaires,
WATTECO vous accompagne. Nos solutions IoT vous permettent de relever ces défis avec efficacité et
durabilité, tout en maximisant vos performances.

## Nos **capteurs**

Vous recherchez un capteur sans fil et autonome en énergie ? Nous avons le capteur adapté à vos
besoins !


### LoRaWAN

Notre large gamme de capteurs connectés exploitent la technologie radio du réseau LoRaWAN® pour de
nombreuses applications, notamment pour le bâtiment.


### BoB Assistant / Movee

BoB Assistant est une technologie de maintenance prédictive et d’assistance opérationnelle qui
surveille en continu les vibrations et les températures enregistrées des systèmes isolés (pompes,
unités de climatisation, unités de refroidissement, ventilateurs, etc.).


### Sur mesure

Notre bureau d’études se mobilise pour votre projet et conçoit votre future application adaptée à
vos besoins et usages.

Julien Bruneau

CEO et co-fondateur, iQspot

« Ce que j’apprécie particulièrement chez WATTECO, c’est la fiabilité de leurs dispositifs,

produits comme Triphas’O, Ventil’O, Vaga’O et ATM’O, que nous utilisons en toute confiance dans des
installations critiques telles que les bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques. »

Benjamin Colboc

Responsable Produit Energie, Trace Software

« Nous avons choisi WATTECO comme partenaire principal pour nos capteurs en raison de la simplicité
d’utilisation, de la robustesse de leurs produits, et de leur réactivité en cas de problèmes. Depuis
plus de cinq ans, WATTECO nous fournit des solutions techniques fiables, parfaitement adaptées à nos
besoins, avec une gamme étendue de capteurs couvrant divers cas d’usage, ce qui simplifie la gestion
et la supervision des consommations pour nos clients. »

Thomas Humeau

Directeur commercial, O-CELL

# IoT Products 
# for all needs

[Energy grid and Photovoltaic][64]
[Industry and Automation][65]
[Public Information System][66]
[Street light systems][67]
[Traffic Managment][68]
[Parking Management][69]

Atreyo designs and manufactures industrial IoT and embedded systems for automation, monitoring, and
control applications. Since 2016, we have been providing reliable products such as  sensors,
communication devices, display units, and custom electronics for various industries.
With in-house R&D, firmware development, and manufacturing, we ensure consistent quality and
support. Our solutions are used in utilities, transportation, energy, and infrastructure projects
where reliability and long-term availability are important.
*  
  
  ## AG-702
  
  ### OpenWRT LTE IoT programmable gateway with RS485, RS232 and I/O
  * **OpenWRT system with custom script support**
  * **Dual Ethernet, WiFi, 4G LTE, GPS and isolated RS485 and RS232**
  * **Additional 512MB memory as overlay**
  * **More than 6000 ready applications**
  
  [Know more][70]
  [AG-702]
*  
  
  ### Smart Street Light
  
  The Atreyo Smart Street Light System is an IoT technology system that completely manage street
  light with hardware support. The system controls each individual luminaire from the server based
  application. The  system is an advanced web application specially adapted for comprehensive
  lighting management.
  
  [Know more][71]
  [Smart light]
*  
  
  ## AG-1629
  
  ### Industrial computer - cellular gateway
  * **Linux operating system**
  * **Dual Ethernet, dual isolated RS485**
  * **Dual SIM, WiFi, LTE, Bluetooth and digital inputs and outputs**
  * **Small size, passive cooling**
  
  [Know more][72]
  [AG-1629 IoT Gateway]
*  
  
  ## AG-743
  
  #### 4G LTE 4 Ethernet industrial router
  * OpenWRT system with custom script support
  * 1x WAN 3x LAN, WiFi, 4G LTE, GPS and isolated RS485
  * Additional 512MB memory as overlay
  * More than 6500 ready applications
  
  [Know more][73]
  [AG-1629 IoT Gateway]

All the products developed at atreyo are industrial grade and capable of withstanding harsh

By the use of the latest digital technologies, our IoT devices provide a high level of data
security.

[easy icon]

The user interface is very important. We use the latest and convenient solutions to make
configuration and management as easy as possible.

* ### Atra-RMS
  
  ATRA-RMS is a dedicated component of the Atra IoT platform, designed to streamline the management
  and monitoring of IoT devices.
   
  
  [Know more][74]

  application. The main benefits is saving of electricity consumption.
