**Welcome to Avelr Smartwatches!**

At Avelr, we take pride in offering innovative and high-quality smartwatches for children and
adults. Whether you’re looking for advanced GPS tracking, fitness monitoring, or customizable
features, we are here to cater to your needs.

ready to assist you. Send us an email at **[[email protected]][26]**, and we’ll provide you with
detailed assistance promptly!

### **Discover Avelr's Featured Smartwatches for Kids and Adults**

**
**Explore our curated selection of Avelr smartwatches, with a focus on models designed specifically
for kids. Our children’s smartwatches offer essential features like GPS tracking, health monitoring,
and Bluetooth calling, providing both safety and connectivity for young users. Additionally, browse
select models tailored for adults, ideal for fitness tracking, wellness, and outdoor adventures. For
our full range of smartwatches, visit our complete catalog.

### **New & Improved - Explore Avelr's Latest Featured Smartwatches**

**
**Discover the innovative and stylish smartwatches in our featured collection. From kid-friendly GPS
tracking and Bluetooth calling watches to advanced health and fitness trackers for adults, Avelr’s
latest models combine technology and style. Perfect for parents looking for safety features or
fitness enthusiasts aiming to reach their health goals. Dive into our selection and find the
smartwatch that fits your lifestyle.

No company can realize the IoT on its own… Within the Eclipse Community, through the contribution of
many IoT developers, tools and standards are created on an open platform that many companies can
benefit from for their IoT applications.

[Picture of Stefan Ferber]

Stefan Ferber / Co-CEO and CTO, Bosch .IO GmbH

Eclipse IoT is the industry’s leading community for Open Source IoT projects. For Red Hat, Eclipse
IoT is the place where we collaborate with like-minded colleagues from other firms to create
projects that form the basis of our IoT products.

[Picture of David Ingham]

David Ingham / Director of Software Engineering, Integration Middleware, Red Hat

Within Eclipse IoT, Eurotech is working with Cloudera, Red Hat, and others to develop key IoT
runtimes and other enabling technologies that will enable integrated, end-to-end open IoT
architectures.

[Picture of Giuseppe Surace]

Finally, DB foresees more open source integrations in the future and looks forward to collaborating
within the Eclipse IoT Working Group. Being part of a collaboration like Eclipse IoT is a good
opportunity to improve DB’s use of open source technology, and in the long term creates better
solutions for DB passengers.

[Picture of Alexander Schmitt]

Alexander Schmitt / Chief Architect, DB-Systel

The Eclipse Foundation [puts] forth great effort to provide open source contributions in the IoT
space, which translates to vitality and enthusiasm. This is very important to us.

The Eclipse Foundation provides individuals and organizations with a business-friendly environment
for open source software collaboration and innovation. The Foundation is home to the Eclipse IDE,
Jakarta EE, and over 375 projects, including runtimes, tools, and frameworks for IoT, edge
computing, automotive, and more. We are a not-for-profit organization supported by over 300 members.

No company can realize the IoT on its own… Within the Eclipse Community, through the contribution of
many IoT developers, tools and standards are created on an open platform that many companies can
benefit from for their IoT applications.

[Picture of Stefan Ferber]

Stefan Ferber / Co-CEO and CTO, Bosch .IO GmbH

Eclipse IoT is the industry’s leading community for Open Source IoT projects. For Red Hat, Eclipse
IoT is the place where we collaborate with like-minded colleagues from other firms to create
projects that form the basis of our IoT products.

[Picture of David Ingham]

David Ingham / Director of Software Engineering, Integration Middleware, Red Hat

Within Eclipse IoT, Eurotech is working with Cloudera, Red Hat, and others to develop key IoT
runtimes and other enabling technologies that will enable integrated, end-to-end open IoT
architectures.

[Picture of Giuseppe Surace]

Giuseppe Surace / Chief Product and Marketing Officer, Eurotech

Finally, DB foresees more open source integrations in the future and looks forward to collaborating
within the Eclipse IoT Working Group. Being part of a collaboration like Eclipse IoT is a good
opportunity to improve DB’s use of open source technology, and in the long term creates better
solutions for DB passengers.

[Picture of Alexander Schmitt]

Alexander Schmitt / Chief Architect, DB-Systel

The Eclipse Foundation [puts] forth great effort to provide open source contributions in the IoT
space, which translates to vitality and enthusiasm. This is very important to us.

[Picture of Nicola La Gloria]

Nicola La Gloria / Co-founder and CEO, Kynetics

## Eclipse Foundation

The Eclipse Foundation provides individuals and organizations with a business-friendly environment
for open source software collaboration and innovation. The Foundation is home to the Eclipse IDE,
Jakarta EE, and over 375 projects, including runtimes, tools, and frameworks for IoT, edge
computing, automotive, and more. We are a not-for-profit organization supported by over 300 members.
Learn more at [eclipse.org.][19]

## FactoryMetrics – A Smart Machine Monitoring Solution

Hiotron, FactoryMetrics (a proprietary end-to-end Industry 4.0 platform) that combines plug-and-play
IoT hardware, AI-driven analytics, and a no-code workflow layer delivers total visibility from
machine to customer, transforming manufacturing operations with intelligent, real-time insights that
drive measurable improvements in production efficiency and quality.

[Explore More ][13]

Case Study

## Successful Case Study : Where Technology Meets Real-World Impact

#### Rico Auto Industries Ltd – BMW Export lines Traceability System

## Project Overview

Rico Auto, a global Tier-1 partner for **BMW**, faced a critical mandate for its Gen-6 high-volume
export lines. In the high-precision automotive world, passing an OEM audit is not just about having
data; it’s about proving a “Digital Thread”—a seamless link between every machining parameter and
the final dispatched part.

## Business Challenge

Before Hiotron’s intervention, traceability relied on a “Fragmented Reality”:
1. **Data Silos:** Important information was spread across paper records, machine PLC data, and
   manual quality logs. Because the data was stored in different places, it was difficult to get one
   clear view of operations.
2. **Time-Consuming Audit Preparation: **Preparing for BMW audits took several days because teams
   had to manually collect and match records from different sources. This made the audit process
   slow, stressful, and resource-heavy.
3. **Risk of Wrong Parts Moving Forward: **Without real-time quality checks and interlocks, there
   was always a chance that a non-compliant part could move to the next stage because of human
   error. This created a serious quality and compliance risk.
4. **Limited Real-Time Traceability: **Operators, supervisors & managers did not have instant
   visibility into the journey of each component. As a result, tracking part status and identifying
   issues quickly was difficult.
5. **Weak Process Discipline at Scale: **Quality teams needed faster access to OK and NG status
   linked to each uniquely serialized part. Management also needed a reliable digital audit trail
   that could be reviewed easily, without depending on manual records. The plant required stronger
   process discipline to ensure that non-compliant parts were stopped before moving ahead.

## Hiotron Solution

Hiotron implemented an end-to-end QR and DPM scanner based part traceability solution tailored for
the **BMW** Gen-6 export lines. Each component was assigned a unique identity, and station-level
events were captured against that identity throughout the production journey.
1. **End-to-end part traceability:** Hiotron built a complete digital traceability system that
   tracked every part across the full production journey.
2. **Unique QR-based identity for every part:** Each component was linked to a unique QR code,
   making it easy to trace its status, history, and movement at any stage.
3. **Critical process and quality data capture:** The system captured important process parameters
   and quality data at every key stage and linked them to each part’s QR journey.
4. **Stage-wise interlocking for quality control:** Hiotron implemented interlocking at every stage
   so that if a part was marked **NG** or the correct process sequence was not followed, it could
   not move forward.
5. **Real-time visibility and OEE monitoring:** Operators, supervisors, and management gained live
   visibility into machine performance, production flow, and OEE for faster decision-making.
6. **One-click report export:** Part-wise, shift-wise, daily, and monthly reports could be generated
   and exported instantly, giving Rico as well as BMW audit teams a complete picture of operations
   and quality performance in just single click
7. **Stronger process discipline and audit readiness:** The solution created a reliable digital
   trail for every part, reduced manual dependency, and made audit preparation faster, easier, and
   more accurate.

## Successful Case Study : Where Technology Meets Real-World Impact

#### Rico Auto Industries Ltd – BMW Export lines Traceability System

## Project Overview

Rico Auto, a global Tier-1 partner for **BMW**, faced a critical mandate for its Gen-6 high-volume
export lines. In the high-precision automotive world, passing an OEM audit is not just about having
data; it’s about proving a “Digital Thread”—a seamless link between every machining parameter and
the final dispatched part.

## Business Challenge

Before Hiotron’s intervention, traceability relied on a “Fragmented Reality”:
1. **Data Silos:** Important information was spread across paper records, machine PLC data, and
   manual quality logs. Because the data was stored in different places, it was difficult to get one
   clear view of operations.
2. **Time-Consuming Audit Preparation: **Preparing for BMW audits took several days because teams
   had to manually collect and match records from different sources. This made the audit process
   slow, stressful, and resource-heavy.
3. **Risk of Wrong Parts Moving Forward: **Without real-time quality checks and interlocks, there
   was always a chance that a non-compliant part could move to the next stage because of human
   error. This created a serious quality and compliance risk.
4. **Limited Real-Time Traceability: **Operators, supervisors & managers did not have instant
   visibility into the journey of each component. As a result, tracking part status and identifying
   issues quickly was difficult.
5. **Weak Process Discipline at Scale: **Quality teams needed faster access to OK and NG status
   linked to each uniquely serialized part. Management also needed a reliable digital audit trail
   that could be reviewed easily, without depending on manual records. The plant required stronger
   process discipline to ensure that non-compliant parts were stopped before moving ahead.

## Hiotron Solution

Hiotron implemented an end-to-end QR and DPM scanner based part traceability solution tailored for
the **BMW** Gen-6 export lines. Each component was assigned a unique identity, and station-level
events were captured against that identity throughout the production journey.
1. **End-to-end part traceability:** Hiotron built a complete digital traceability system that
   tracked every part across the full production journey.
2. **Unique QR-based identity for every part:** Each component was linked to a unique QR code,
   making it easy to trace its status, history, and movement at any stage.
3. **Critical process and quality data capture:** The system captured important process parameters
   and quality data at every key stage and linked them to each part’s QR journey.
4. **Stage-wise interlocking for quality control:** Hiotron implemented interlocking at every stage
   so that if a part was marked **NG** or the correct process sequence was not followed, it could
   not move forward.
5. **Real-time visibility and OEE monitoring:** Operators, supervisors, and management gained live
   visibility into machine performance, production flow, and OEE for faster decision-making.
6. **One-click report export:** Part-wise, shift-wise, daily, and monthly reports could be generated
   and exported instantly, giving Rico as well as BMW audit teams a complete picture of operations
   and quality performance in just single click
7. **Stronger process discipline and audit readiness:** The solution created a reliable digital
   trail for every part, reduced manual dependency, and made audit preparation faster, easier, and
   more accurate.

[BMW Gen-6 part traceability dashboard]

1. **100% part traceability:** Each serialized part can now be traced from source material through

2. **Zero defect escapes:** NG parts are held at source instead of progressing downstream.
3. **Audit-ready records:** Customer and internal teams can retrieve part history instantly during
   audits and investigations.
4. **Lower manual effort:** Digital tracking reduced dependence on paper-based traceability and
   manual record reconciliation.

# We believe the Internet changes lives.

## But only when people can access, trust, and use it safely.

[a dynamic collage of images, showcasing a blend of colors and themes]

## We believe the Internet changes lives.

## But only when people can access, trust, and use it safely.

## **We’re working to connect more than 2 billion people worldwide who are still offline, and make
## the Internet safer and more trustworthy. **

[**Learn About Our Work**][33]
[Participants at a community networks training from the Haiti Chapter stand outside]
[A group of girls sitting on a sidewalk with a woman in the middle holding laptop]

### 2025 Annual Report

### 2025 Annual Report

**In 2025, we worked in 150 countries and territories, supporting community-centered connectivity
initiatives, helping safeguard the multistakeholder model of Internet governance, scaling our
philanthropic impact through new funding partnerships, and so much more.**

The report outlines how our global community rose to the challenge of our ambitious five-year
strategy to expand affordable, reliable access and ensure that people everywhere are safe and secure
online.

[**Read Our Report**][34]
[[Three women sit on the grass outside]][35]

### [Community-Centered Connectivity Initiatives Earn Viddy Awards Recognition][36]

**Our global community works tirelessly to expand connectivity, educate users, and build the
Internet we want—an Internet for everyone. **

We are proud to share that four videos highlighting community initiatives have won Viddy Awards this
year.
[[People stand outdoors celebrating the completion of the Internet hub in the Siripi zone, waving at
the camera.]][37]

### [From Email to Case Study: What We Learned About Connecting Refugee Communities in Just One
### Year ][38]

**In Uganda’s Rhino Camp Refugee Settlement, we helped train refugees and community members to use
the Internet and build their own networks. **

Now, two fully operational, community-owned digital hubs serve over 4,500 people.
[[A graphic showing an email notification]][39]

### [Anatomy of a Scam][40]

**Online scams are at an all-time high, and digital tools have enabled them to become more
sophisticated, more convincing, and more widespread. **

Luckily, with the right information, you can learn how to identify online scams and keep yourself
safe. Let’s take a look at some common warning signs.
[**Read Our Blog**][41]

### In partnership with our global community, we are building and advocating for an Internet for
### everyone.

### In partnership with our global community, we are building and advocating for an Internet for
### everyone.

[a young woman with braided hair and red lipstick posing for a photo]

> The Internet Society has consistently demonstrated the transformative power of community,
> inspiring me through its efforts to build vibrant, empowered networks of individuals. Their work
> not only energizes community members but positions them as the driving force behind meaningful
> change.”
> Lily Edinam Botsyoe, Alumni and Member, Internet Society Ghana Chapter

Our Hybrid Network Management System offers a solution for organisations of all sizes, from PoC to
large-scale production.

Flexibility and interoperability are at the heart of our solution, giving our customers complete
freedom in terms of technology to use, hardware and application platform.
